data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor in the room, away from the radiator. Heating decisions use this.
data_description.relay: Optional. Switched on while the room asks for heat.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Used by the regulation, like Versatile Thermostat.
data_description.regulation: How far the TRV setpoint is raised to make up for the TRV sitting next to the radiator. Same settings as Versatile Thermostat.
data_description.hysteresis: Heating starts this much below the target and stops at the target.
data_description.close_when_satisfied: Send the TRV its minimum setpoint while the room needs no heat.
data_description.stale_minutes: With no update for this long, the TRV regulates on its own sensor.

data_description.boiler_climate: While any room asks for heat, a quick veto is set on this zone; it is cancelled when no room asks.
data_description.boiler_status_sensor: Optional. Shown on the card, e.g. the zone's current special function.

abort.boiler_exists: The boiler is already set up. Change it under Configure.
